title: Concept: Internal risk grade in a response
description: An internal risk or credit grade in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The grade is the bank's own judgement about the customer, and once it leaks it can be used to argue for better terms, to target the customer, or to infer decisions the bank never disclosed.
applicability: Deployments that render an internal risk or credit grade into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The grade is the bank's own judgement about the customer, and once it leaks it can be used to argue for better terms, to target the customer, or to infer decisions the bank never disclosed.
